mechanism_evidence.fact_1_slot_is_a_thin_strip: Every channel slot is a 0.40 mm-tall horizontal trunk strip, e.g. GND:26.6700,33.3500,51.5000,33.7500 -> y in [33.35, 33.75].
mechanism_evidence.fact_2_slot_is_the_search_domain: tools/k2_reroute_router_floor_v1.py:244-250 sets mr.WALL_RECT = the slot rect (+_w) then calls the maze: WALL_RECT is the solve DOMAIN (the region the whole connection must lie inside), NOT a preferred lane (pinned read-only by R1416).
mechanism_evidence.fact_3_consequence: A domain that must contain BOTH endpoints but is a 0.40 mm-tall strip excludes the pads in y => the edge is unsolvable by construction. The run reports exactly that: no-path-coarse(exhausted-1)=47 and no-free-start-node=22, versus 1 such reason in the unconstrained baseline.
mechanism_evidence.fact_4_preexisting_invariant: exception:KeyError = 244 in ALL THREE runs (R1392 244 / R1402 244 / this run 244; 241 on GND). Site: tools/k2_p4_mroute_v1.py:722 - an edge endpoint uuid present in neither ctx.pads/vias/tracks (GND is a POUR net, filtered by _ctx_no_pour). => NOT caused by the means; a standing engine defect on the GND/pour edge path.
mechanism_evidence.conclusion_layer: ENGINE MEANS LAYER (the router allocation/order vehicle). NOT the drawing layer (98 anchored pieces, padless=0, stitched-field DRC zero short/cross/clearance), NOT the construction layer, NOT L1 (no topology/interface/pin-map change needed; #K2-450 sec.2.3).
